name: calendar_command
description: Open the Jarvis Calendar and manage tasks or answer schedule questions. Use for ANY calendar request: viewing upcoming events, adding tasks, marking things done, deleting events, or checking availability.

parameters.description: The calendar operation. Use 'add_task' to add an event/task. 'complete_task' when something is done. 'delete_event' to remove/cancel an event. 'list_tasks' for a specific day's schedule. 'get_upcoming' for this week's schedule or availability questions. 'clear_tasks' to remove all tasks from a day. 'go_to_date' to navigate the calendar view.
ISO date string YYYY-MM-DD. Extract from what the user said, e.g. 'tomorrow' → next day, 'Friday' → upcoming Friday. Omit for today.
Task or event text. For 'add_task': the full description. For 'complete_task' or 'delete_event': the partial name to match.
Optional time label for a task, e.g. '3:00 PM', '9:30 AM'. Extract from the user's request if a time was mentioned.
